data.desc: Established in 2016, Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in developing its private skincare label, direct skincare product sales and franchise promotion under the proprietary brand 'Park Ha', with a commitment to providing cost-effective solutions to skin problems and improving the confidence of women in need of skin treatment. As of October 31, 2025, the Company has five directly operated stores and 22 franchisees in China. As part of its value-added service for the products, the Company offers 'light beauty experience', a quick complimentary after-sales beauty service performed in the directly operated stores and franchise stores.
